application.validation: 15/15 corrected rows pass the live model, explicit city/region bbox and production-parity checks

finding: The first import validated against the repository's generous region margin, but 15 rural tree candidates would have appeared under city or region pages 44-121 km away. Those assignments are replaced with exact municipalities or honest named regions rather than treating technical bbox validity as geographic meaning.

policy.corrected: Assignments over 40 km whose current page label describes a different municipality, park or physical region.
policy.retained: Nearby metropolitan or explicitly regional assignments up to 23 km where the existing page remains an honest walking-area label.
policy.hills: All 12 raw-bbox-edge hill assignments are legitimate metropolitan objectives, 5-34 km from their city centre; no hill retag is required.
